name: vendor-ops
description: Vendor and tool operations for the systems a team coordinates in rather than builds: issue trackers, knowledge wikis and compliance platforms. Confirming a tracker connection points at the right workspace before writing, restraint about whose tickets you touch, filing a document in the collection its own taxonomy asks for, the wiki write calls that report success and change nothing, and remediating a compliance platform that reads live cloud state rather than code. Every workspace value comes from a profile.
